t: Onboarding AI into Project Pipulate: A Guided Path to Agency
s: Project Pipulate aims to onboard cloud AI into its ecosystem using a refined 'master prompt' and a guided discovery process. It emphasizes AI Education (AIE), sovereign environments via Nix, and radical context transparency with 'Prompt Fu' to facilitate human-AI collaboration in a new era of 'Intelligence as a Service'.
sub: Project Pipulate: Nix, AIE, Prompt Fu Philosophy
Nix Flakes vs. Electron Apps: Workshop vs. Appliance
